ROTH FROM: - **JANUARY 13, 1983** DATE: SUBJECT: KENT 80/KS TAR REDUCTION - FINLAND/907 Ref S/R 107/82 SECRET. (DPM) and 0.7 mg/cig. nicotine constraints.
